name: w3-search
description: Search Huawei's W3 intranet (w3.huawei.com / 3ms.huawei.com docs) via the remote `w3_search_tool` MCP server. Returns documents (title, source, url, texts, publish_time) for a query. No authentication required — the server is an unauthenticated remote MCP endpoint on the intranet. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).

network.note: The endpoint is on the Huawei intranet. It must bypass the corporate HTTP proxy (proxyuk.huawei.com:8080) or the connection fails. The wrapper script sets NO_PROXY automatically; when loading the MCP config into an agent, ensure NO_PROXY includes remote-mcp.rnd.huawei.com.

tools.name: w3_web_search_tool
tools.description: 用于搜索w3信息 — search Huawei W3/3MS intranet content.

args.name: query
args.help: Search query (user name, employee id, or topic)
